Provide the table.

I have all the data I need. Here is the complete analysis, based entirely on the tool results.

## 1. The ten liver tissue‑enriched genes (highest liver consensus nTPM)

From `proteinatlas` ("RNA tissue specificity" = *Tissue enriched*, specific tissue = liver) joined to `rna_tissue_consensus` (Tissue = liver). The specific-tissue nTPM equals the consensus liver nTPM:

| Rank | Gene | Ensembl | Liver consensus nTPM |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ALB | ENSG00000163631 | 198 523.8 |
| 2 | HP | ENSG00000257017 | 55 848.1 |
| 3 | SAA1 | ENSG00000173432 | 54 032.7 |
| 4 | ORM1 | ENSG00000229314 | 42 168.4 |
| 5 | APOA2 | ENSG00000158874 | 33 506.8 |
| 6 | SERPINA1 | ENSG00000197249 | 31 416.7 |
| 7 | SAA2 | ENSG00000134339 | 31 118.2 |
| 8 | APOC3 | ENSG00000110245 | 28 690.9 |
| 9 | APOA1 | ENSG00000118137 | 20 151.0 |
| 10 | APOC1 | ENSG00000130208 | 18 659.9 |

## 2. Interaction partners per seed gene (`interaction_consensus`, pairs de‑duplicated)

```
APOA1  |██████ 6
APOA2  |██ 2
HP     |█ 1
ORM1   |█ 1
ALB    | 0
SAA1   | 0
SERPINA1| 0
SAA2   | 0
APOC3  | 0
APOC1  | 0
```
Only four of the ten seeds have any recorded partner in `interaction_consensus`: **APOA1 (6), APOA2 (2), HP (1), ORM1 (1)** — 10 partners in total.

## 3. Distribution of partners' main subcellular location (`Subcellular main location`)

```
Cytosol            |██ 2   (MAPK6, CREB3)
Not annotated      |██ 2   (SNCA, SERPINE1 — blank in atlas)
Golgi apparatus    |█ 1    (APP)
Plasma membrane    |█ 1    (ABCA1)
Nucleoplasm        |█ 1    (LCAT)
Vesicles           |█ 1    (HP)
Principal piece    |█ 1    (CATSPER1)
```

## 4. Scatter: partner liver nTPM vs. seed liver nTPM (log axes)

Point = (seed liver nTPM, partner liver nTPM):

```
HP        (55 848.1) ── APOA1             (20 151.0)
ORM1      (42 168.4) ── SERPINE1          (   323.1)
APOA2     (33 506.8) ── CREB3             (    30.1)
APOA2     (33 506.8) ── CATSPER1          (     0.0)   ← cannot be placed on a log axis
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── HP                (55 848.1)
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── APP               (   251.5)
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── LCAT              (   275.5)
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── ABCA1             (    36.2)
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── MAPK6             (    33.0)
APOA1     (20 151.0) ── SNCA              (     2.9)
```
On log–log axes the ten points span roughly x = 2×10⁴–5.6×10⁴ and y = 2.9–5.6×10⁴; CATSPER1 (partner nTPM = 0) has no defined log value. One point (APOA1 vs HP) is a mutual seed–seed interaction, and it lies far above all others.

## 5. Partners secreted to blood (`Secretome location` = "Secreted to blood")

**APP, LCAT, HP, APOA1, SERPINE1** (5 of the 10 partners). The remaining partners are not annotated as secreted to blood: MAPK6, ABCA1, CREB3, CATSPER1 (no secretome annotation) and SNCA ("Intracellular and membrane").

## 6. Full table

| Seed | Seed liver nTPM | Partner | Partner main location | Partner liver nTPM | Partner secretome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | MAPK6 (ENSG00000069956) | Cytosol | 33.0 | — |
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | APP (ENSG00000142192) | Golgi apparatus | 251.5 | Secreted to blood |
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | SNCA (ENSG00000145335) | *(not annotated)* | 2.9 | Intracellular and membrane |
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | ABCA1 (ENSG00000165029) | Plasma membrane | 36.2 | — |
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | LCAT (ENSG00000213398) | Nucleoplasm | 275.5 | Secreted to blood |
| APOA1 | 20 151.0 | HP (ENSG00000257017) | Vesicles | 55 848.1 | Secreted to blood |
| APOA2 | 33 506.8 | CREB3 (ENSG00000107175) | Cytosol | 30.1 | — |
| APOA2 | 33 506.8 | CATSPER1 (ENSG00000175294) | Principal piece | 0.0 | — |
| HP | 55 848.1 | APOA1 (ENSG00000118137) | Vesicles | 20 151.0 | Secreted to blood |
| ORM1 | 42 168.4 | SERPINE1 (ENSG00000106366) | *(not annotated)* | 323.1 | Secreted to blood |
